claims.head: The Bruins can’t afford to take penalties
claims.call: The Mammoth’s power play creates at least their usual 8.4 expected goals per 60.
claims.body: The Bruins’ penalty kill is near the bottom of the league, and the Mammoth’s power play is one of the league’s best. Discipline matters more than usual for the Bruins tonight.
claims.nums: Utah 5th for power play (8.4 expected goals per 60) · Boston 27th for penalty kill

claims.head: Sheltered against exposed
claims.body: The Bruins are near the top of the league for preventing dangerous shots, at the sheltered end; the Mammoth are one of the league’s worst, at the exposed end. Expect that gap to show.
claims.gist: The Bruins and the Mammoth sit at opposite ends for preventing dangerous shots.
claims.call: The Bruins prevent dangerous shots better than the Mammoth do.

BOS.head: A tough matchup for Boston
BOS.body: Utah has controlled the play far better over recent games and Boston has home ice. Boston’s best way through is keeping dangerous shots away.

UTA.head: Utah has a lot going for them
